notes.title: Development Report: Progress on Version 1.7.0
notes.content:
We are currently working on Version 1.7.0. Because this update includes major additions and changes, it is taking extra time for licensing approval.

Main Changes:
[list]
[*]TGM Style Control Behavior Updated
We’ve revised control inputs for all modes playable in TGM Style.
【【【Important 】】】
As a result, the following replays from versions earlier than 1.7.0 can no longer be viewed:
・All replays played in TGM Style
・Versus-mode replays
・SHIRANUI replays
[*] Planned Addition of New Game Rules in Marathon Mode
(Currently under review by the licensor.)
[*] Result Screen Flow Changed
After gameplay ends, the way “RESULT” is displayed has been updated.
・Previously: “Game Over” appeared first, then the performance evaluation.
・From Ver.1.7.0 onward: “RESULT” is shown immediately after gameplay ends, followed by “Game Over.”
・The RESULT screen varies by game mode.
[/list]
Other Changes & Fixes:
[list]
[*] Adjusted the title-ranking system in NORMAL Mode (now easier to earn titles).
[*] Added title icons to NORMAL Mode.
[*] Fixed an issue where, when entering the preview screen from 2P (right-side) gamepad or keyboard settings, the preview still used 1P’s settings.
[*] Updated some text in the Options menu.
[*] Fixed a bug in “Race Replay” where, if you selected “Retry” from the pause menu mid-play, the BGM could restart at unexpected times.
[/list]

Discussions: https://steamcommunity.com/app/3328480/discussions/0/597406028056775445/

notes.title: Ver.1.6.0 Patch Update Notice
notes.content:
We have now released the Version 1.6.0 update.
The main changes are as follows:

Update Details:
[list]
[*] Added EASY and HARD modes to ASUKA Mode
HARD mode can only be selected by players who hold the ASUKA MASTER title.
Note: Players without the title can still load and practice using those replays.
[*] New KONOHA (Easy) Category
※In Practice → Replay, all options except the Event Mode category have been removed.
[*] Added KONOHA (Easy) Leaderboard
[*] Marathon Mode Line-Clear Counter
※Marathon Mode now displays the number of lines cleared in its category.
Note: Pre-update replay data will show as “0.”
[*] Guideline Revisions
Since these changes affect attack power in all versus modes, versus-mode replays recorded on versions earlier than 1.6.0 can no longer be viewed.
Marathon Mode scores will be affected, but existing replays will still play back (displayed scores may differ).
[*] Overhauled Input Device Handling
Only XInput devices are supported.
Up to 4 keyboards and 8 controllers can now be recognized.
Any connected device can be used for menu navigation during gameplay; the device used to start the game will be assigned to in-game controls.
[*] Font Change for Medal Counts in Master Mode
[*] Added Entries to Credit Roll #2
Winners’ list for Event 2
Champion, runner-up, and third-place lists for CTWC 2025
[*] VSYNC Indicator Update in Windowed/Borderless Fullscreen
VSYNC will display as “On” when the primary display’s refresh rate is a multiple of 60 Hz.
[*] Exit Fix on Gamepad/Keyboard Settings Screen
You can now exit the settings menu even if some buttons remain unassigned.
[*] Added Core-Dump Output Feature
A new “Advanced Settings” submenu has been added under Options.
You can configure crash-dump output (default: “None”).
Dumps are written to:
　[i][b]C:\Users\<YourName>\AppData\Local\tgm4\dump[/b][/i]
Files are named [i][b]tgm4_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.dmp[/b][/i] (approx. 150 MB, or up to 3 GB in full-size mode).
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in ASUKA Mode replay playback where the fox animation would sometimes glitch.
[/list]

Discussions: https://steamcommunity.com/app/3328480/discussions/0/603034577716487106/

notes.title: Development Report: Notice of Version 1.6.0 Update
notes.content:
We are currently in the process of rolling out the Version 1.6.0 update.

----------------------Correction---------------------- 2025/06/25 17:31 (JST)

Due to a scheduled facilities inspection of the tenant building, we would be unable to provide emergency support if we proceed with the release this weekend.
Therefore, we will postpone the release until next week.

----------------------Correction----------------------

[strike]This update is scheduled to be completed by the end of this weekend.[/strike]

Update Details:

[list]
[*] Added EASY and HARD modes to ASUKA Mode
HARD mode can only be selected by players who hold the ASUKA MASTER title.
Note:
　Players without the title can still load those replays for practice.

[*] Guideline Revisions
・These adjustments affect attack power in all versus modes, so any versus-mode replays recorded on versions earlier than 1.6.0 will no longer be viewable.
・Marathon mode scores will be affected, but existing replays will still play back (displayed scores may change).

[*] Overhauled Input Device Handling
・Only XInput devices are supported.
・In the new system, up to 4 keyboards and up to 8 controllers can be recognized simultaneously.
・Any connected input device can be used to navigate menus while the game is running, and the device used to start the game will be assigned to in-game controls.

[*] Winners’ list for Event 2
Champion, runner-up, and third-place lists for CTWC 2025

[*] Changed VSYNC Display in Graphics Options
In windowed or borderless-fullscreen mode, VSYNC will show as “On” when the primary display’s refresh rate is a multiple of 60 Hz.

[*] Menu Exit Fix in Gamepad/Keyboard Settings

[*] You can now exit the settings menu even if some functions remain unassigned.

[*] Added Core Dump Output Feature
A new “Advanced Settings” submenu has been added under Options.
You can now configure dump output on application crash (default: “None”).
Dumps are written to
[i][b]/LOCALAPPDATA/tgm4/dump[/b][/i]
with filenames like `tgm4_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.dmp`
(approx. 150 MB, or up to 3 GB in full-size mode).
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] ASUKA Mode Replay Playback: Corrected a glitch in the fox animation during replay.
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update: Upcoming Update Plans
notes.content:
We’d like to share the current roadmap for upcoming TGM4 updates.

■ Update Schedule:
The update is planned for a short time after Hirajima-P returns from CTWC (Classic Tetris World Championship).
We aim to have all implementations announced today completed by late June.
We appreciate your patience and hope you’re looking forward to it!

■ Major Additions & Changes:
[list]
[*]  Input System Overhaul
Support for DirectInput devices will be discontinued.
Moving forward, only XInput devices will be supported.
This overhaul will also bring a more modern input architecture, including multi-keyboard support.
[*] Implementation of ASUKA EASY / ASUKA HARD
[b]ASUKA EASY[/b]
A new mode designed for players who’ve played NORMAL or MARATHON and want a more relaxed way to enjoy the game.
No unlock requirements.
[b]ASUKA HARD[/b]
A challenging mode available only to players who have earned ASUKA MASTER qualification.
[*]Unlocking of ROUNDS Numbers in MASTER Mode
The grading tiers in MASTER mode will be unlocked.
You can already check this information via existing replay data.
[/list]
■ Bug Fixes & Optimization:
We will continue to address minor bugs and performance optimizations as they arise.
Our goal is to make sure everyone can enjoy TGM4 in the best environment possible.

Thank you as always for your support ? we look forward to bringing you more updates!

Discussions: https://steamcommunity.com/app/3328480/discussions/0/603031542017570056/

notes.title: CTWC2025 TGM4 Side Tournament Commemorative Event
notes.content:
This time, the event is themed after TGM3’s Shirase Mode.

We encourage everyone to take on the challenge!
You may attempt it as many times as you'd like!

■ How to Participate:

1. Download the Replay Files:
https://app.box.com/s/1copo7hwfj3w58wtkb9xttt6uxer0rax

Filename: asuka20250522.rar

This archive contains two files:

asuka_20250521_190646.bin → for STANDARD

asuka_20250521_191430.bin → for TGM


2. Place the Files in the Following Folder:
C:\Users\[Your PC Username]\AppData\Local\tgm4\savedata\[Your Steam ID]\replay_data\

Note: You can place the files in a subfolder within replay_data.

3. Launch the Game and Take the Challenge:
Menu Navigation:
PRACTICE → Practice from Replay → Event Mode → Select Replay → Race Against Replay

Choose ASUKA TGM 2025/05/21 19:14

choose ASUKA STANDARD 2025/05/21 19:06

Gameplay Conditions:
Follow the in-game replay conditions exactly as they are presented.


■ Streaming & Posting Encouraged!
Why not livestream or upload your playthrough?
Note: Replays will not be saved for this challenge to prevent cheating.


■ Awards & Prizes:
Multiple winners will be selected based on complete clears, entertainment value, and creativity.
Winners’ submission names will be featured in the newly added in-game Credits 2.
Top-ranked players in the upcoming CTWC in June will also receive the same honors.


■ Event Details:
Event Period: May 22, 2025, 13:09 to May 29, 2025, 23:59 (JST)

Eligibility: TGM4 owners (excluding users who have been disqualified from the tgm_series)

Submission Method:
Post your run on a freely accessible platform like YouTube or Twitch
Include #tgm4 #hira_p_evnt02 in your video title


■ Additional Notes:
If a submitted player name contains inappropriate content, we may ask you to change it.

Awards may be revoked at the discretion of the event organizers.
Please participate with understanding and good sportsmanship.

In the case of any serious issues, the event may be canceled at the discretion of Mihara.

notes.title: Ver. 1.2.2 Patch Update Notice
notes.content:
This is an announcement for the Ver. 1.2.2 update.

※ This update will not affect existing replay data.

Graphics Settings Changes

After updating, the game will launch in full borderless mode on the primary monitor, and graphics settings will be reset on first startup.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, and kindly ask that you review and reapply your graphics settings after the update.

[list]
[*] Changed the method used to retrieve monitor display names
[*] Added version information to tgm4.ini
[*] If the game window is positioned outside the screen area, it will now reset to the top-left (0,0) position
[*] Adjusted behavior when graphics settings cannot be retrieved, to properly reset configuration values
[/list]

Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some text was not being displayed on the Achievements screen
[*] Fixed an issue in “Practice in Game Mode” where the Tetris Guide could still appear even after being disabled in the pause menu
[*] Fixed an issue in the medal settings screen under “Practice in Game Mode” where left/right arrows were not displayed correctly

notes.title: Development Update: This is a technical update on our ongoing work.
notes.content:
This is a technical update on our ongoing work and recent reports we have received from users.

▼ Issue: Game Progress Being Reset (Reported by Some Users)
Some users have reported that their game progress appears to be reset upon restarting the game.

We would like to first provide a potential recovery method for those affected by this issue.

We have implemented a backup system within the game that stores up to 10 previous versions of save data.
These backups include progress information and option settings.

Backup location:
C:\Users\[YourUserName]\AppData\Local\tgm4\savedata\[SteamID]\backup

Files:

option.01.ini ~ option.10.ini

status.01.ini ~ status.10.ini

If your progress has been lost, please try the following recovery procedure:

Navigate to the folder above.

Choose the lowest-numbered backup file (e.g., option.01.ini, status.01.ini).

Copy and rename it to overwrite the current files in the following directory:

Save data location:
C:\Users\[YourUserName]\AppData\Local\tgm4\savedata\[SteamID]

Overwrite these files:

option.ini

status.ini

If the files still appear corrupted, try using the next backup in sequence.

Current Analysis and Findings:
To be fully transparent ? we do not yet know the exact cause of this issue.
We acknowledge the possibility that this could stem from a coding error on our side.

Based on the information provided by users who reported the problem, the following commonalities were noted:

The issue became noticeable after restarting the game.

Steam Cloud was enabled during the time of data loss.

Beyond these two points, we were unable to identify any consistent patterns.

We did, however, manage to reproduce a similar case internally under the following conditions:
After quitting the game, if Steam attempted to upload save data to Steam Cloud,
and the user closed the Steam client before the sync completed,
there were rare cases in which save data was lost upon the next launch.

We suspect that when the game tries to load the save data but finds it incomplete or corrupted,
it may treat the environment as if it were a first-time launch, and reset the data accordingly.

As a temporary and cautious countermeasure,
we kindly ask that players disable Steam Cloud for this game.

We are continuing to investigate the issue and working on a permanent solution.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

▼ Issue: Detection by Windows Defender (Trojan:Script/Wacatac.C!ml)
Some users have reported that Windows Defender flags the game as “Trojan:Script/Wacatac.C!ml.”

We have thoroughly checked the original code to rule out the possibility of an actual virus,
and we have found no malicious content or infection within the codebase.

We are confident that this is a false positive.

What is "Trojan:Script/Wacatac.C!ml"?
It is a broad, generic detection label used by Microsoft Defender to flag software that behaves “suspiciously,” even if it is harmless.

Script: Despite the name, this label can be applied to programs that do not contain JavaScript, VBScript, or any scripting at all.

Wacatac: Not tied to a specific malware family ? used generically for questionable behavior.

.C!ml: Indicates that the threat was flagged via machine learning algorithms.

We have already submitted a false positive report to Microsoft.

We will continue to monitor and investigate this issue as well.
Again, we apologize for the trouble and thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Development Update: Current Status Report
notes.content:
Here is the latest report on the current situation.

[list]
[*] DirectInput Issue
Similar to the AVX issue, this game does not officially support DirectInput.
While we are not removing support immediately, we kindly ask users who are using DirectInput devices
to switch to Steam Input if possible.
 
[*] AVX Issue
Currently, we are testing AVX-only systems (without AVX2) to allow the game to run,
but this is causing performance issues for some users on AVX2-capable systems.
Given that there is nearly a 4x performance difference in processing capability,
it is difficult to continue supporting both environments equally.
We kindly ask users to consider upgrading to AVX2-capable hardware if possible.
 
Additionally, Mac and similar platforms are not officially supported.
Attempting to support these systems through forced detection could be risky and unstable,
so for now, we are releasing the game with the understanding that it may not run on such environments.
We plan to conduct further tests when the timing is appropriate.
 
[*] Spoiler Issues Due to Unauthorized Activity
We’ve observed that spoiler content from game data analysis is being spread
through community forums and external sites.
 
As previously stated, we have no intention of restricting discoveries made
through players' own legitimate gameplay and skill.

However, data mining and reverse engineering diminish the value of the product?
and more importantly, they can also undermine the achievements of skilled players,
which is deeply disappointing.

At the very least, we kindly ask that such unauthorized spoilers not be posted on this community board.
[/list]

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Development Update: Progress Report
notes.content:
One cause of the startup freeze issue has been identified:
We have confirmed that the issue occurs for users whose CPUs do not support AVX2 instructions.

For reference:

Intel CPUs support AVX2 starting with the Haswell architecture, released in June 2013.

AMD CPUs support AVX2 starting with the Excavator architecture, released in June 2015.

In the next update, we plan to implement a message that will notify users if their CPU does not meet AVX2 support requirements.
We sincerely apologize, but these environments fall below the minimum system requirements and are not supported.
Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

For users experiencing other startup issues, please try the following:
[list]
[*] Install DirectX 9
https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=35
[*] With Steam Cloud turned OFF, delete the following file:
C:\Users\xxxxx\AppData\Local\tgm4\tgm4.ini
Then try launching the game again.
※ Note: The AppData folder is hidden by default. If you cannot find it, please enable the option to show hidden files in your system settings.
[/list]
Update Schedule:
Keyboard binding support for both Japanese and English (US) keyboards is scheduled to be implemented by this Friday.

As part of this update, we are also considering the following changes:
・Disable “charge cancellation continuation”
・Add a diagonal input option
・Retain past ranking data even if old replays are no longer playable
These features are also scheduled to be implemented on Friday.

Regarding MASTER Mode Difficulty:
We have determined that there is a significant difficulty gap between control styles,
so we are planning to add an optional assist feature for visual guidance.
Additionally, we plan to add assist display options to the textbook practice mode as well.

For any other updates or fixes not listed here, we will provide details as soon as they are ready.

Thank you for your continued support and patience.

Thank you for all the feedback.
In particular, thank you for your comments regarding keyboard bindings.
This is our first time working with keyboard controls,
so we released the game according to the Tetris Guidelines as specified.
We will consider improvements to keyboard binding in future updates.
This limitation is partly due to the fact that TGM was originally developed for the Japanese arcade market.
Since arcade cabinets only had arcade controllers, there was very little reference or data related to keyboard play.
Additionally, for fairness, certain simultaneous inputs that are not possible with arcade sticks are currently disabled.
That said, we will continue to review and adjust this in the future.
Regarding the issue where the game does not launch,
we are currently investigating based on the information provided by users in their reports.
For the issue where the game launches but does not respond to input,
please check the following points first:
[list]
[*] To enable low-latency input, only devices connected before launching the game are recognized.
[*] If more than one device is connected that is recognized as a controller via USB,
the keyboard may not be assigned input.
[*] If you wish to play with a keyboard, make sure no more than one USB controller-type device is connected.
[*] Please launch the game after connecting the desired device.
[/list]
Thank you for your continued support of TGM4.
